text: area | Check both; if map shows covered but Service Status flags an outage, wait for restoration | | No coverage, area shown outside footprint | Location is outside current tower coverage | Coverage map boundary for the exact location | Report the location so it can be logged for network planning | ### Escalation Reporting the location to the Network team is the documented path when coverage is genuinely absent rather than temporarily degraded. ### Example Scenario **Customer situation:** A customer has no signal at home and checks the app's coverage map. **What happens:** If the map shows their area as covered, the likely cause is either obstruction or an active outage, best confirmed by checking Service Status; if the map shows the area outside the footprint, reporting the location is the relevant next step instead. ### Related Information Related documents referenced in NovaTel's internal metadata for this topic: KB_C08_overview.
